news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: NeurAxis reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.9 million, up 116% year-over-year, with gross margin expanding 230 basis points and cash on hand of $8.3 million as of June 30, 2026. Growth was driven by the new Category I CPT code for PENFS that took effect January 1, 2026, which substantially broadened payer reimbursement for IB-Stim.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its PENFS/IB-Stim therapy representing over 500,000 covered lives, expanding incremental access for beneficiaries in the Mid-Atlantic region.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis announced it would report Q2 2026 financial results (period ended June 30, 2026) before market open on August 11, 2026, with a conference call at 9:00 am ET the same day, setting the stage for the subsequent record-revenue report.

news.headline: NeurAxis Files Form S-3 Resale Registration Statement
news.summary: NeurAxis filed an S-3 registering the resale of 1,923,194 shares of common stock by selling stockholders/directors (999,418 resale shares plus 923,776 shares underlying RSUs), a technical filing that creates potential future selling pressure but is not itself a capital raise.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Series B Preferred Stock Dividend
news.summary: The Board approved a Q2 2026 stock dividend on Series B Preferred Stock, to be paid entirely in common shares (approximately 80,463 shares at a $2.38 calculation rate) on July 29, 2026 to holders of record as of July 21, 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and business update call
catalysts.detail: Following its quarterly reporting cadence (Q1 on May 12, Q2 on Aug 11), NeurAxis is expected to report Q3 2026 results and host a business update call, which should show whether the CPT-code-driven 116% revenue growth pace is sustainable.

catalysts.label: Continued payer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Company continues to add regional/national medical policy coverage decisions for PENFS/IB-Stim (most recently 500k+ covered lives in the Mid-Atlantic on Aug 4, 2026), building on the Category I CPT code (effective Jan 1, 2026) that already unlocked over 50 million covered lives nationally.

catalysts.label: Cash-flow breakeven target
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to roughly $15M in annualized revenue needed for cash-flow breakeven, alongside a targeted burn rate of about $1M/quarter or less for the remainder of 2026.

catalysts.label: RED (Rectal Expulsion Device) and VA channel ramp
catalysts.detail: Commercialization of the RED chronic-constipation device continues alongside the VA Federal Supply Schedule contract (effective Dec 2025, VA sales launched Jan 2026); management said on the Q1 2026 call that VA adoption was running ahead of initial expectations, making the pace of RED/VA revenue contribution a swing factor for 2026 growth.

pulse: NeurAxis posted record Q2 2026 results on August 11, with revenue up 116% year-over-year to $1.9 million and gross margin expanding 230 basis points, as the new Category I CPT code for PENFS (effective January 2026) continues to drive payer reimbursement and unit growth for IB-Stim. The company keeps stacking incremental payer wins, most recently a Mid-Atlantic policy expansion on August 4 covering over 500,000 additional lives, while ending the quarter with $8.3 million in cash. Sentiment remains bullish following the beat, with the next major catalyst being Q3 2026 earnings expected in the fall to confirm whether the reimbursement-driven revenue ramp toward the company's ~$15M breakeven target is sustainable.
